# smtpfast_segment (Data Source)

Look up an existing segment by its name or ID, for example one created in the dashboard, to pass its ID to your application. Needs a provider API key with the `contact:read` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a segment up by name, for example one created in the dashboard...
data "smtpfast_segment" "customers" {
  name = "Customers"
}

# ...or by id.
data "smtpfast_segment" "by_id" {
  id = "seg_abc123"
}

output "customers_segment_id" {
  value = data.smtpfast_segment.customers.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the segment. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) The segment's name, matched exactly (case matters). Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) The segment's hex color, or null.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) What the segment is for, or null.
